hostRules.description: Pace ghcr.io to 1 request/s. GHCR lists tags oldest first, 1000 per page, so the ~222k-tag immich-machine-learning lookup is ~222 back-to-back requests, and a 429 mid-crawl surfaces as a 'no-result' lookup failure. 1/s crawled every page without a 429. No hostType: Renovate's throttle matches rules by URL only.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge low-risk updates after a soak period for stability
Require manual review for major updates
Group and auto-merge GitHub Actions updates after a short soak

No soak and no auto-merge for images outside Docker Hub (ghcr.io, lscr.io, quay.io, any other registry host). The docker datasource reads release dates only from Docker Hub, and since Renovate 42 a minimumReleaseAge treats an undated release as pending forever: these updates sat under Pending Status Checks until ticked, renovate/stability-days never passed and none ever auto-merged. Open their PRs at once and merge by hand; to auto-merge one, add a later rule for it with automerge true (it gets no soak).
Use native ordering for stable LinuxServer build tags; exclude commit hashes, prereleases, branch/arch aliases and legacy Ubuntu tags

Stay on libtorrent v2 (6.x switches to libtorrent v3) and hold qBittorrent at 5.2.x. 5.3.0 ships libtorrent 2.1.2 (torrents stall at 100%: qbittorrent/qBittorrent#25123, #25130; memory growth: #25202) and WebAPI 2.16, which drops skip_checking, so every cross-seed v6 injection forces a full recheck; its config migration is one-way. Allow 5.3 once a release fixes those and cross-seed supports WebAPI 2.16.
Track only FileBrowser Quantum's stable channel; the registry also publishes -beta tags for the same version
Skip Zigbee2MQTT 2.14.3: Ember adapters over TCP drop every few minutes and ZBDongle-E hits route errors (Koenkk/zigbee2mqtt#33574, #33609); 2.14.2 is stable. Remove once a fixed release ships.

Never auto-merge the Proxmox CSI chart: it runs the controller and node plugin for every retained block volume, and its slot budget and topology are an ansible/terraform contract. Review each bump by hand.

Never auto-merge any image in the PostgreSQL pod. All four are rolling :latest tags pinned by digest. A postgresql digest bump can silently cross a PostgreSQL major, and Postgres refuses to start on a data directory written by a different major; a glibc change also invalidates collation-dependent indexes. The others are no safer to take blind: a broken os-shell or busybox init container leaves the pod stuck in Init, and postgres-exporter has a readiness probe, so if it fails the pod goes NotReady and the database drops out of its Service endpoints. File-scoped so images added to this chart later are covered too.

postgres:18.6-alpine is the qualified enrollment, backup and cutover client. Its digest is baked into enrollment ConfigMaps (job-template.json, hook names), the reviewed cutover archive and test constants that Renovate cannot rewrite, so every Renovate bump fails CI (#1250). New digests and versions wait on the Dependency Dashboard; bump them by hand with regeneration

Never bump postgres in the two enrollment Job manifests. They must match job-template.json in enrollment-configmap.yaml (the acceptance generation), which Renovate cannot rewrite, and the consumer values pin the same digest in a repository/digest form Renovate does not parse, so a Renovate bump here only desyncs them (#1531, #1550). Bump all of them together by hand with regeneration.
Require manual review for Home Assistant pod image updates because Home Assistant and Matter Server are a compatibility pair

Group the Authentik Helm chart and its outpost docker images into a single PR — they release in lockstep and must be upgraded together. internalChecksFilter none keeps both in one PR while the chart soaks (strict drops whichever member is still pending and splits the group); the soak still shows as the renovate/stability-days check. Never auto-merge: a run that sees only the chart update (outpost image not yet published, or its ghcr lookup failed) would otherwise merge the chart alone and leave the outpost behind the server

Keep immich-server and immich-machine-learning in the immich monorepo group by name. The built-in group matches on sourceUrl, which Renovate reads from the image labels; when that label fetch hits a ghcr 429, the image silently leaves the group (as in #509 and #512). Same groupName and update types as the preset, so the branch stays renovate/immich-monorepo. A failed tag lookup can still split the group, so check that both images moved before merging.
Merge Karakeep Meilisearch engine updates manually: a version change discards the rebuildable index (ADR 0010), so search is empty until an admin runs Reindex All Bookmarks.
Retained Stirling H2 filename and engine need storage-format review before an image update

customManagers.description: Update default app-template in cluster-apps AppSet
Update Helm charts in app.yaml via JSONata. A repo without a scheme (ghcr.io/...) is an OCI registry, which the helm datasource cannot read, so it goes to docker as <repo>/<name>.
matchStrings: chart.{ 'depName': $contains(repo, '://') ? name : repo & '/' & name, 'registryUrl': $contains(repo, '://') ? repo, 'currentValue': version, 'datasource': $contains(repo, '://') ? 'helm' : 'docker' }
